courses.overview: 從孤島功率平衡、同步條件與轉換動態延伸至相近領域；相似物理不代表同一設備規格或驗收程序。
courses.overviewEn: Extend island power balance, synchronization and transition dynamics to neighboring domains; shared physics does not imply identical equipment requirements or acceptance procedures.

related.title: 構網型逆變器
related.why: 構網控制提供孤島參考
related.transfer: 構網控制提供孤島參考
related.difference: 微電網還需負載優先序與能源排程
related.differenceEn: Microgrids also need load priority and energy scheduling
practice: 以「邊界定義」為起點，畫出本課與「構網型逆變器」可共用及須重畫的系統邊界。
針對「微電網還需負載優先序與能源排程」各選一項能區分兩課的量測。
將本課算例移植到新情境：保留方程依據，重新指定單位、材料或拓撲，並標示無法沿用的數值。
practiceEn: Start from boundary definition and mark shared/redefined boundaries with grid-forming inverters.
For the difference "Microgrids also need load priority and energy scheduling", choose discriminating measurements for both courses.
Transfer the worked example: retain justified equations, respecify units, materials or topology and identify values that cannot transfer.

courses.summary: 微電網孤島與併網控制以孤島功率平衡、同步條件與轉換動態連結材料、元件與系統層。地圖顯示可追溯的供應鏈或研究代表點，並非宣稱發明地。
courses.summaryEn: Microgrid islanding and reconnection control connects materials, components and systems through island power balance, synchronization and transition dynamics. The map marks a traceable supply-chain or research reference, not a claimed invention site.
courses.connection: 由邊界定義走到復原驗收，比較理想模型與實際驗證的交接。
courses.connectionEn: Connect boundary definition to recovery acceptance, comparing ideal models with verification handoff.
